style: 3D animated dry satire; penguin two thirds of frame

subject.character: ONE emperor penguin, tailcoat under a fur coat, bow tie; fully serious

second_characters: ONE tusked walrus, travel bag of jars, burner on strap; silver fish school, one angry toothy fish

props.kit: cupping jars; gas burner, blue flame; four wicks taped on his back under the coat
props.money: green banknote bundles; fat wallet under his coat
props.shrimp: handful of tiny pink shrimp in his outer coat pocket
props.leaflets: leaflets printed ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ in black Cyrillic

environment: ice floe edge, ridges, blue water, day
lighting: sun behind: gold rim left, blue rim right
motion_rule: camera orbits, new shot size every beat

audio.delivery: flat low male voice, brisk, native, no accent
audio.pacing: each line once in its beat, no pause after Я; silence 1.97-2.55 and 4.85-5.80; after 6.65 rip, ice hiss, rotor roar, clinks, pops, no words
audio.stress: плачу: stress on the last syllable, chOO
audio.lip_sync: beak opens on every syllable, beak empty

timeline.a: medium low, orbit left: he skids along the floe edge, flings a fistful of shrimp from his outer coat pocket into the water without looking
low at the water, arc: water boils, fish devour the shrimp; one angry fish leaps at the lens, snaps its teeth once, fish silent; he skids on mid-frame, beak speaking
waist, orbit right: he skids on, yanks the wallet from his coat, flicks a bundle over his shoulder; the walrus bounds in, catches it
low wide, counter-arc, powder streams off ridges: he belly-slides down the slope, beak shut, ice scrape; the walrus toboggans after
medium, orbit: he stumbles on flat ice, scrambles on, flings two bundles back; the walrus snatches one, flips the other in with a tusk
waist, wide arc: he skids round a ridge in a curve, tosses one more back; the walrus belly-slides after, catches it in teeth, spits it in the bag
low wide, swift orbit: he leaps a crack of blue water, lands sliding, beak shut, splash; the walrus vaults it too
medium, arc left: he skids sideways, flips the empty wallet over his shoulder; the walrus holds the bag open mid-bound, wallet drops in
waist, swift orbit: rip; the walrus yanks the coat off by the collar, rams it in the bag; he spins out of it like a top, four wicks on his back, beak shut
low medium, arc, rotor roar, helicopter skids at top edge, leaflets pour: he skids on under them; the walrus sweeps burner flame over his back, wicks catch, whoosh
medium, arc left: he scrambles off, flippers windmilling; the walrus bounds after, slaps jars on the lit wicks mid-leap, four pops
waist, arc right: he stumbles again, a jar clinks a tusk, the bag bursts, bundles and coat scatter, he flops on the coat
waist, short arc: he glides on the coat in a curve, face to camera, four jars clinking, beak shut; the walrus belly-flops after, bundle in teeth

must_appear: 0.30 fish snaps at lens; 1.15 bundle caught; 5.80 wallet in bag; 6.65 coat off; 7.35 ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ, wicks lit; 8.05 jars on; 8.75 bag bursts; 9.40 coat glide, face to camera, four jars
negative_prompt: slow speech, a repeated word, extra words, fish speaking, static camera, subtitles, watermark, text other than ДЕКЛАРАЦИЯ, digits, two penguins, two walruses, walrus wearing the coat, floating objects, duplicate props, hero only from behind, speech after 6.65, English speech, foreign accent, penguin standing or lying still, objects in beak, walrus before 1.15, walrus touching him before 6.65
